summary: IREN Limited filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, announcing the closing of its acquisition of Mirantis, Inc. via a merger with Kube Merger Sub Inc., under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated May 4, 2026. The deal closed on August 3, 2026. IREN also filed a prospectus supplement registering 11,981,668 ordinary shares for resale by selling shareholders, satisfying registration rights from the merger. Allens provided legal counsel. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The resale registration signals potential overhang; watch trading volume and Mirantis integration milestones.
